# Inertia form page

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

create/store or edit/update methods, a FormRequest, an Action for the write and a toast on the redirect.

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make page --flavor=form <Name>`.

Kit: @kit/ui FormCard, @kit/ui Field, @kit/ui FormActions.
- `Page` from `@kit/ui` for the page shell: Wraps the form page (props: title).
- `FormCard` from `@kit/ui` for the form: The form surface (props: title, @submit).
- `Field` from `@kit/ui` for the field: Label, input slot and error (props: label, error).
- `Input` from `@kit/ui` for the input: Text input inside a Field (props: v-model, name).
- `FormActions` from `@kit/ui` for the submit: Submit and cancel buttons (props: processing).
Checks: 20, 21, toast, actions, descriptors. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "What does the page mainly do?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=ui-page.form` to see its siblings.
